title: Auto Loans: Division of a Scheduled Installment Payment
content:
This rule settles how a scheduled Auto Loans payment taken by PCB from the borrower's checking account, on the installment the loan is behind on, divides among fees, interest and principal once the payment amount, the fees share and the accrued interest are known.

## Rule

- The **interest share** is the smaller of the accrued interest and the part of the payment amount that remains after the fees share, that remainder being taken to the cent.
- The **principal share** is whatever is left of the payment amount after both the fees share and the interest share, expressed to the cent.

The three shares always add back to the payment amount, and the principal share can never be negative, because interest is limited to what the fees share leaves.

## Examples (invented figures)

| Payment amount | Fees share | Accrued interest | Interest share | Principal share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 280.40 | 25.00 | 41.46 | 41.46 | 213.94 |
| 50.00 | 25.00 | 41.46 | 25.00 | 0.00 |
| 312.00 | 0.00 | 41.46 | 41.46 | 270.54 |

In the second row the payment is too small to reach principal at all: 25.00 remains after fees, and all of it goes to interest.
